items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: I remember he became real big, and Helen Forrest, so they had a romance there for a while, Helen Forrest.

ctx.x: Yeah, I mean until the end of time. I remember he became real big, and Helen Forrest, so they had a romance there for a while, Helen Forrest. Who else?
